summary.en: Three chapter cards hang in one 3D space; the camera holds on each, flies to the next as its title rises, then pulls back to show all three under the closing line.
summary.zh: 三张章节卡悬在同一个 3D 空间里，相机逐张停留、飞往下一张，标题随落位升起，最后拉远看全三张，收尾一句话升起。

fits: A film or section told in three steps or chapters, with a line that sums them up (demo, turn, lockup).
notFor: More or fewer than three steps; chapters that need more than a title and a line; a camera that should stay still.

intent.en: Three steps told as three places in one space: each chapter gets its own angle, and the pull-back at the end shows how they make one whole.
intent.zh: 把三步讲成同一空间里的三个地方：每章换一个空间视角，最后拉远让观众看到三者合成一个整体。

content.en: Three chapters, each a kicker (≤ 14 chars, Chinese ≤ 6 characters), a one-word title (≤ 9 chars, Chinese ≤ 4) and a line (≤ 40 chars, Chinese ≤ 14); a closing headline (≤ 20 chars, Chinese ≤ 8).
content.zh: 三章，每章一个眉题（≤ 14 字符、中文 ≤ 6 字）、一个单词标题（≤ 9 字符、中文 ≤ 4 字）和一行说明（≤ 40 字符、中文 ≤ 14 字）；收尾标题（≤ 20 字符、中文 ≤ 8 字）。

fits.zh: 分三步或三章讲的一支片或一段，加一句总括（演示、转折、落版）。

notFor.zh: 多于或少于三步；每章要的不只是一个标题加一行字；镜头应当不动。

en: Keep the text on the rolled third card short; it only reads once the camera rights it.
zh: 侧躺的第三张卡字要短；转正后才读得出。

upstream.name: 空间步进演示
upstream.summary: impress.js 式空间演示：卡片以不同位置/旋转/缩放散布 3D 空间，相机取各步姿态之逆依次飞行对齐，末步拉到 OVERVIEW 总览
upstream.use: 概念/路线图/三步法的空间化讲述；替代平面 slides 的"每一步都换个空间视角"
upstream.energy: 中（每次转场有空间惊喜，停留段安静读卡）

overlaps.note: pose-fly is one flight between two cards; space-steps chains three of them with holds, the chapter content and the closing plate
chapter-push pushes through flat chapter cards; space-steps flies between cards posed in 3D
